reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 4 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Heat (revenge).
Bottom line: the Pistons win 60 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 204 and 253 total points.
